hints.title: Dynamic Property Interception with Proxies
hints.text: Creating an object that dynamically answers any arbitrary method invocation requires intercepting property lookups.

hints.title: Proxy Get Trap Returning Key Names
hints.text: Wrap an empty target inside a Proxy. In the get trap, return a function that returns the queried property name as a string.

hints.title: Proxy Trap Blueprint
hints.text: Return new Proxy({}, { get(target, prop) { return () => String(prop); } }).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Proxy interception evaluates dynamically in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Static objects cannot anticipate unknown method identifiers requested at runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Virtualizing properties via Proxy eliminates upfront property allocation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of JavaScript Proxy get trap returning closure.
